evidenceBoundary.note: Proves the API generator enforces the doc-coverage policy and that generated routes build deterministically under the GitHub Pages base path.

limits.dartCoverage: The Dart lane enforces presence of all 81 ledger declarations in the dartdoc index; dartdoc index.json carries no comment-coverage signal, so Dart undocumented-export ratcheting is not enforced.
limits.rustCoverage: Rust lanes assert rustdoc artifacts exist and index; symbol-level coverage policy applies to npm ledgers only.
